Overview

  • Power Input

First-Time Setup

  1. Remove all packaging materials.
  2. Install the PEI Sheet.
  3. Mount the filament spool.
  4. Connect the power cable.
  5. Insert the USB drive (if printing from USB).
  6. Turn ON the printer.

Installing the PEI Sheet

  1. Ensure the magnetic build plate is clean.
  2. Hold the PEI sheet by its edges.
  3. Align the rear edge first.
  4. Lower the front until it sits flat.
  5. Ensure the sheet is fully seated.

Installing Filament

  1. From the Home Screen, Filament > Change Filament
  2. The printer automatically heats the nozzle to approximately 220° and moves the extruder into loading position.
  3. Remove the old filament if installed.
  4. Place the new filament spool onto the spool holder.
  5. Feed the filament through:

Guide Tube

  1. Insert the filament into the tube and press Next.
  2. The printer automatically loads the filament.
  3. Wait until melted filament begins extruding.
  4. Remove the purged excess filament.
  5. Return to the Home Screen.

Printer Calibration


Calibration should be performed before the first print and whenever the build plate changes.
  1. Tap Tools.
  2. Tap Settings.
  3. Tap Home Extruder.
  4. Wait until all axes finish homing.
  5. Tap Calibration.
  6. Place a standard A4 paper on the PEI sheet.
  7. Adjust the nozzle height until, the paper slides smoothly, slight resistance is felt. Recommended gap: 0.05 mm
  8. Press Accept to save the calibration.
Print

USB Printing

  1. Insert the USB drive.
  2. Select Print.
  3. Choose USB.
  4. Select the required model.
  5. Verify the Material
  6. Temperature
  7. Layer settings
  8. Press Start
  9. During Printing monitor:
    1. First Layer
    2. Nozzle Temperature
    3. Bed Temperature
    4. Filament Feed
    5. If abnormal behavior occurs, Press STOP immediately.
    6. Pause & Resume Printing.

Pause Printing

During printing, tap Pause and find available options include:
  • Adjust Print Settings
  • Change Filament
  • Resume Printing

Once the required action is complete, Tap Resume.

The printer continues printing from the paused position.

Changing Filament during Printing

  1. Tap Pause.
  2. Select Change Filament
  3. Wait for the nozzle to heat.
  4. Remove the old filament.
  5. Insert the new filament.
  6. Allow the printer to purge the old material.
  7. Remove the purged filament.
  8. Tap Resume
  9. Printing continues.

Print Removal

  1. Wait until the bed cools.
  2. Remove the PEI sheet.
  3. Flex the PEI sheet gently.
  4. The printed object will release.
  5. Reinstall the PEI sheet before the next print.

Best Practices

  • Keep the PEI sheet clean.
  • Clean the nozzle regularly.
  • Ensure the filament spool rotates freely.
  • Keep filament dry.
  • Watch the first printing layer.
  • Never forcefully remove printed objects.
  • Calibrate whenever changing the PEI sheet.
  • Keep the front door closed during printing.
  • Open the top cover when printing PLA if additional cooling is recommended.
